_comment: Optional. Delete this file and everything still works with defaults.
'ignored' lists plugin names (the filename without .js) not to load.
'config' is handed to each plugin as plugin.config.
'urls' lists https URLs fetched at every boot.
Each has an environment variable that REPLACES it, which is the only way
on a host where this file cannot be edited:
PLUGINS_IGNORED= (empty) or [] means nothing is ignored, so it can undo
what this file says. Deleting a URL from PLUGINS_URLS is how you stop
fetching it - there is no separate switch for that.
Nothing ships ignored. healthz is bundled but binds nothing unless a port
is asked for, so it costs nothing to leave loaded.
